cards.card_text: Job says they'd even cast lots for an orphan and barter away their friend.
cards.verse_text: You would even cast lots for an orphan and barter away your friend.
cards.snippet: You would even cast lots for an orphan and barter away your friend.

cards.card_text: Isaiah says these lawmakers make widows their prey and orphans their plunder.
cards.verse_text: to deprive the poor of fair treatment and withhold justice from the oppressed of My people, to make widows their prey and orphans their plunder.
cards.snippet: …from the oppressed of My people, to make widows their prey and orphans their plunder.

cards.card_text: But right in the middle of all that, the LORD speaks about Edom's orphans.
cards.verse_text: Abandon your orphans; I will preserve their lives.
cards.snippet: Abandon your orphans; I will preserve their lives.

cards.card_text: The LORD tells Edom to abandon their orphans, and says He will ___ their lives.
cards.verse_text: Abandon your orphans; I will preserve their lives.
cards.snippet: Abandon your orphans; I will preserve their lives.

cards.card_text: Then it gets personal: they've become fatherless orphans, and their mothers are widows.
cards.verse_text: We have become fatherless orphans; our mothers are widows.
cards.snippet: We have become fatherless orphans; our mothers are widows.

cards.card_text: Then Jesus says, "I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you." Friend, I spent years in the back of a drawer, so that line gets me right in the apron.
cards.verse_text: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.
cards.snippet: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.

cards.card_text: Orphans and widows Prophets and priests Kings and rulers
cards.verse_text: Pure and undefiled religion before our God and Father is this: to care for orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.
cards.snippet: …undefiled religion before our God and Father is this: to care for orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself from being polluted…
